test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Ramu borrows Rs. 64,000 at 25% per annum compound interest. At the end of every year he pays Rs. 3,200 as part of repayment. How much does he still owe after 3 such instalments?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 64,000

Rate of interest (R) = 25% per annum

Installment paid at the end of each year = Rs. 3,200

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest formula: A = P (1 + (R)/(100))^n

Where:

A = Amount after n years

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per annum

n = Number of years

**Calculation:**

After 1st year:

A₁ = 64,000 × (1 + 25/100)

A₁ = 64,000 × 1.25

A₁ = 80,000

Amount after 1st installment:

Amount owed = 80,000 - 3,200

Amount owed = 76,800

After 2ⁿd year:

A₂ = 76,800 × (1 + 25/100)

A₂ = 76,800 × 1.25

A₂ = 96,000

Amount after 2ⁿd installment:

Amount owed = 96,000 - 3,200

Amount owed = 92,800

After 3rd year:

A₃ = 92,800 × (1 + 25/100)

A₃ = 92,800 × 1.25

A₃ = 1,16,000

Amount after 3rd installment:

Amount owed = 1,16,000 - 3,200

Amount owed = 1,12,800

**The correct answer is option 3, Rs. 1,12,800.**
